html:
SMTO-EXE-0087 — The screen SMTO wanted to capture is no longer connected

GUID: 142f9ec0-61bd-50b2-b63c-5322f4d7ebc5
Slug: screen-stale-display
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: screen

What happened

  • SMTO tried to capture a specific screen, but that screen is no longer connected or has changed since SMTO last looked. Nothing was captured.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you recently unplugged, added or rearranged monitors, make sure the one you want is connected, switched on and awake. SMTO can only capture a screen the computer currently lists.
  2. In the same chat, ask SMTO to list the screens on that computer again. A fresh list gives SMTO the current name of each screen instead of an old one.
  3. Then ask SMTO to capture the screen you want from that new list. Capturing right after the fresh list uses a screen that SMTO knows is there.

What success looks like

  • SMTO returns a screenshot of the screen you asked for.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it, with how your monitors are set up, to the person who manages that computer. Don't ask SMTO to capture a different computer's screen instead.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A capture named a display_id that is not in the Gateway's current display enumeration, or macOS ScreenCaptureKit could not resolve the matching native display.

What this means

  • A requested display identity no longer matched current display enumeration, or the macOS capture API could not resolve its native display target. Screen and OCR observations occur only through their existing explicit request and permission flow. Rendering diagnostics neither captures pixels nor reads additional content, and no failed observation is silently repeated.

Why this can happen

  • A requested display identity no longer matched current display enumeration, or the macOS capture API could not resolve its native display target.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the requested display ID with screen.displays from the same Gateway and current session.

How to fix it

  • Call screen.displays on the same Gateway and retry the capture with a display_id from that fresh result; display identities change when monitors are added, removed or rearranged. On macOS the error is also raised when the Quartz display ID has no match in SCShareableContent.
  • Call screen.displays on the same Gateway and choose a current display ID.

Retry and execution caution

  • Call screen.displays on the same Gateway and choose a current display ID.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended current display identity resolves before an explicit capture.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass OS permissions, capture another Gateway, or copy screen content to diagnostics.

Technical notes

  • Screen and OCR observations occur only through their existing explicit request and permission flow. Rendering diagnostics neither captures pixels nor reads additional content, and no failed observation is silently repeated.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
